I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X and LinkedIn fail on hard rules, and Bluesky passes.

- **X:** it fails because of the `#AIAgents` hashtag. The suggested copy drops it and leaves everything else as is (178 of 255 characters).
- **LinkedIn:** it fails because the opening sentence uses "I" ("I have watched this happen on every team I have worked with"). The blog post doesn't back up that claim either, so I dropped the sentence instead of swapping in "we". The suggested copy is 444 of 2950 characters.
- **Bluesky:** it passes at 182 of 300 characters. I left out the advisory suggestions section because I didn't find any notes worth adding.

I checked character counts and the specifics against the blog post myself. I didn't launch the critique or suggestions sub-agents that SKILL.md describes.

The file has the marker line, the `> [!NOTE]` line, the collapsed suggested-copy section and the requested footer. I also added the two comment prompts from SKILL.md's CI section (apply the suggestions, and `/social-review` to re-run).
